releases.body:
First release, published as `@balcsida/sol-opencode` (the unscoped name is taken by another port).

SoL-Pi's four mechanisms for OpenCode 2.2.3: Action Fusion, ObservationPack, Evidence-Preserving Reducer and Online Context Compact. Everything is opt-in, see docs/configuration.md.

Install: add `@balcsida/sol-opencode` to `plugins` in opencode.jsonc with the configuration as options (README, "Install").

Online Context Compact uses OpenCode's own compaction (`session.compact`, available since OpenCode 2.1), see docs/compatibility.md for the differences from SoL-Pi and docs/verification.md for the zero-spend live runs on 2.2.3.
